sofa_ids=set()
for item in cart_res.get('cart_items', []):
    if 'sofa' in item.get('product_name','').lower():
        sofa_ids.add(item['product_id'])

print('sofa_ids', sofa_ids)

sofa_items=[item for item in cart_res.get('cart_items', []) if item['product_id'] in sofa_ids]
print('sofa_items', sofa_items)

expected_move={item['product_id']: item['quantity'] for item in sofa_items}
print('expected_move', expected_move)

move_results=[]
for pid, qty in expected_move.items():
    res=apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(product_id=pid, access_token=amazon_token, quantity=qty)
    move_results.append({'product_id':pid,'quantity':qty,'result':res})
    print('moved', pid, 'qty', qty, '->', res)

print('move_results_count', len(move_results))

print('globals_has_expected_move', 'expected_move' in globals())
print('globals_has_amazon_token', 'amazon_token' in globals())
print('globals_has_sofa_ids', 'sofa_ids' in globals())

# Verification: show cart and wish list, then check sofa products
cart_after = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
wish_after = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)

cart_items = cart_after.get('cart_items', [])
wish_items = wish_after

# Identify sofa items by name containing 'sofa'
cart_sofa = [it for it in cart_items if 'sofa' in it.get('product_name','').lower()]
wish_sofa = [it for it in wish_items if 'sofa' in it.get('product_name','').lower()]

cart_sofa_ids = {it['product_id'] for it in cart_sofa}
wish_sofa_ids = {it['product_id'] for it in wish_sofa}

print('cart_total_items', len(cart_items))
print('cart_sofa_count', len(cart_sofa))
print('cart_sofa_ids', cart_sofa_ids)

print('wish_total_items', len(wish_items))
print('wish_sofa_count', len(wish_sofa))
print('wish_sofa_ids', wish_sofa_ids)

# Quantity check for wishlist for the moved sofas
# Build quantity lookup by product_id (wishlist quantity may be float; cast)
qty_in_wish = {}
for it in wish_sofa:
    pid = it['product_id']
    qty_in_wish[pid] = qty_in_wish.get(pid, 0) + it.get('quantity', 0)

print('qty_in_wish_for_moved', {pid: qty_in_wish.get(pid) for pid in (expected_move.keys() if 'expected_move' in globals() else [])})

# Success criteria:
# 1) Cart has 0 sofa items
# 2) Wishlist includes all moved sofa product_ids
success_cart = (len(cart_sofa)==0)
moved_ids = set(expected_move.keys())
success_wish = moved_ids.issubset(wish_sofa_ids)
print('success_cart', success_cart)
print('success_wish', success_wish)
print('moved_ids', moved_ids)

success = success_cart and success_wish
print('VERIFICATION_SUCCESS', success)
